relationships.claim: The glomerular filtration barrier includes specialized podocyte foot processes and slit diaphragms; disruption of this barrier can impair filtration-barrier function and contribute to proteinuria.
Kidney function assessment extends beyond glomerular filtration and includes tubular physiology, renal circulation, urinalysis, acid-base handling, and proteinuria assessment.
